note: All-ages RV resort, golf course and freshwater marina on the Caloosahatchee River (the Okeechobee Waterway) about 14 miles west of Lake Okeechobee, between the Moore Haven and Ortona locks; cabin and park-model rentals and park-model sales. Short- and long-term stays.
summary: Operator's pages: confirmed full hookups (amperage not stated for RV sites); added 360 sites, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi hotspots, phone booking with policies, military 20% and Passport America 50% discounts (not Jan-Mar). No RV rates posted ('please call 863-983-8070'), so fees stay unknown. Note corrected: the resort is on the Caloosahatchee River 14 mi west of Lake Okeechobee, not on a rim canal at Moore Haven.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'not waterfront', but the operator says the resort is 'ideally situated ... along the Caloosahatchee River' with an on-site freshwater marina, boat ramp, 'Riverfront Grill' and 'The Caloosahatchee River - On Site' (https://www.thegladesresort.com/our-marina, /rv-sites).
No posted rate: 'For our current rates and availability please call 863-983-8070' (https://www.thegladesresort.com/rv-sites). Price indicator is only RV Life's $$ tier.

Possible long-stay park (AWH five-test rule): rules address 'Lessee'/'annual residents' (monthly rent and electric due the 1st, hard sewer plumbing required of annual residents), park-model sales, 'for a day, weekend, week, month, season or a lifetime', and no discounts Jan-Mar. It does take daily stays with posted daily discounts and a check-in time, so not clearly failing.
